# Vinyl-Oid

> Free AI-powered identification tool for vinyl records. Upload a photo of the
> label, dead wax, or sleeve and Vinyl-Oid identifies artist, pressing, matrix
> numbers, and value. Chat with Uncle Kevin — audiophile, free-festival
> veteran, "it's all about the music, not the gear" — for hi-fi and
> record-care advice.

Vinyl-Oid is part of the FeelFamous -Oid ecosystem, built by Chris P Taylor
(Doc Strange).

## Core tool — free, no sign-in

- Photo identification of vinyl records (label, dead wax, sleeve) — artist,
  pressing, matrix numbers, estimated value
- Ask Uncle Kevin — chat about hi-fi gear, record care, pressing plants,
  matrix numbers, Goldmine grading, UK/US/Jamaican labels
- No account required, no lock icon, no gated tier for the core tool
